turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My work friends want me to host a potluck and I've no clue what to make as the host.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could do a huge pot of chili with all the toppings on the side, so people build their own bowls.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a taco bar, which is fun, but it means warming tortillas all evening while people arrive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a couple of big roasted trays, like sausages and vegetables, which basically cook themselves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The chili is my pick, it sits happily on the stove and people can help themselves whenever they turn up. The taco bar is the most fun, but you'd be stuck warming tortillas. The roasting trays are easy too, just less of a centerpiece.
